piezas.titulo: Reading words: Numbers, age and basic details
texto: Reading and spelling of numbers and classifiers: notice the short closed vowel ึ in «หนึ่ง» with the initial consonant ห นํา น (the high-class consonant ห makes the nasal น behave as low class, so it takes a low tone). In «สอง» and «สาม», ส is a high-class consonant in a live syllable (with no tone mark), which gives a natural rising tone. «อายุ» is written with the initial consonant อ, the long vowel า and the final syllable ยุ, with the short vowel ุ under ย (high tone). Identifying these letters lets you read calendars, dates and phone numbers.

pregunta.texto: Which natural tone do the words «สอง» (two) and «สาม» (three) take when they have a high-class initial consonant (ส) in a live syllable with no mark?

opciones.texto: Rising tone (เสียงจัตวา)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: a high-class consonant in a live syllable with no tone mark is always pronounced with a rising tone.
Incorrect: it would need a mái eek (่) mark to be a low tone.
Incorrect: high-class consonants without a mark never produce a high tone.
